cond_0001.intro:
We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy, and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through difficult or ambiguous client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research: experience managing the full market research cycle including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Quantitative methodologies: knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Analytical thinking: experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings and generate consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Strategic thinking: able to tie research to client business goals and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Attention to detail: able to manage the details that have a significant impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project without losing sight of the big picture.
Preferred Requirements
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors.
Commitment: ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and ensure reliable results on time and on budget.
Learning + application: able to demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater responsibility.
We are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

cond_0256.intro: We're looking for a Strategist or Senior Strategist of Quantitative Marketing Research + Strategy. The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record and a passion for finding and shaping actionable insights through expert quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quantitative data and how it connects to brand and business strategy.
cond_0256.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as a part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics, (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0256.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Primary marketing research: experience managing the full market research cycle including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting and presenting
Quantitative methodologies: knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing
Analytical thinking: experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines
Strategic thinking: able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable
Attention to detail: without losing sight of the big picture, able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project
Preferred Requirements
Communications: exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors
Commitment: ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget
Learning + application: can demonstrate that basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working
Interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.)

A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with team members, clients, and vendors to keep projects moving and aligned. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots, and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and able to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish — including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and actively coordinating fieldwork and vendors with other team members on a daily basis.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and connect regularly with the team on advanced analytics (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients — speaking up a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, surface issues early, and solve problems together.
Show calm, grit, and tenacity when navigating through difficult or ambiguous client situations.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding, and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0321.requirements:
Primary marketing research — experience managing the full market research cycle including survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting findings clearly to others.
Quantitative methodologies — knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Analytical thinking — experience analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research findings, generating consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines.
Strategic thinking — able to tie research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Attention to detail — without losing sight of the big picture, able to mind all the details that have a significant impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project.
Communications — strong listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; comfortable interacting and liaising directly with clients and vendors on a regular basis.
Commitment — ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and ensure reliable results on time and on budget.
Learning + application — can demonstrate that concepts taught and guidance received are internalized and applied, building foundations that allow for exposure to more complex projects and greater responsibility.
In sum, we are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).
cond_0321.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.

Candidates should have hands-on primary marketing research experience, preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context, and be data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0452.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as a part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics, (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0452.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven track record in primary marketing research, including demonstrated expertise managing the full market research cycle: survey design, fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, development of recommendations, reporting, and presenting.
Deep knowledge of quantitative methodologies across a range of market research studies, such as segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing.
Substantial experience analyzing data and translating findings into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate research results and generate impactful consumer insights through thought-provoking headlines.
Exceptional communication skills, including strong listening ability; proven ability to manage logistics, calendars, and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; and demonstrated effectiveness liaising with clients and vendors.
Strong command of strategic thinking — able to tie research to client business objectives and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture — able to manage the fine details that have a significant impact on overall project experience and outcome.
Demonstrated ability to leverage resources to navigate challenges, find solutions, and deliver reliable results on time and on budget.
Proven ability to internalize concepts and guidance and apply them independently, building foundations that support exposure to more complex projects and greater autonomous responsibility.
We are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).

The successful applicant will have a demonstrable track record in finding and shaping actionable insights through quantitative data analysis. Candidates should be developing strategists, with hands-on primary marketing research experience (preferably within a brand or innovation strategy context) who are data savvy and growth minded.
cond_0460.responsibilities:
The Strategist / Senior Strategist will work as part of the brand and innovation strategy teams to support primary quantitative research that advances our clients' insight, brand strategy and innovation business goals. This position requires you to recognize patterns, connect dots and ultimately help develop the strategic vision underpinning each engagement. To be successful, this individual must be highly analytical, a self-starter, responsive, open and receptive to feedback, and have the ability to apply new learnings across multiple projects.
Manage the research process from start to finish including the initial phases of developing surveys based on client objectives, testing programs, and managing fieldwork and vendors in conjunction with other team members.
Provide initial thinking and frameworks that can lead to the development of compelling, visual report narratives conducive to insightful brand, customer, and business strategies.
Support analytic plan development and partner with the team on advanced analytics, (e.g., MaxDiff, factor analysis, cluster analysis, derived importance, choice modeling, etc.).
Manage multiple projects on time and within budget while applying the full rigor of quantitative methods.
Work collaboratively with senior team members and account leads to proactively advise clients, thinking a few steps ahead to anticipate needs, get ahead of any issues, and solve problems.
Show calm, grit and tenacity when navigating through ""grey"" or difficult client experiences.
Serve as an effective peer-to-peer collaborator with colleagues and a mentor to more junior strategists, growing in comfort and ability to provide and accept constructive criticism to improve performance.
Contribute to proposals, case studies, project debriefs, onboarding and ongoing education initiatives.
cond_0460.requirements:
Primary marketing research (experience/interest in managing the full market research cycle including survey design; fieldwork and data management, data analysis, data interpretation, and development of recommendations; reporting and presenting)
Quantitative methodologies (knowledge of and/or experience with a range of market research studies, such as: segmentation, brand equity, perceptual mapping, conjoint analysis, and concept testing)
Analytical thinking (experience in and comfort with analyzing data and translating it into high-quality PowerPoint presentations that effectively communicate the research finding, generating impactful consumer insights through data analysis and thought-provoking headlines)
Strategic thinking (able to tie the research to the business of our clients and develop insights and implications that are relevant and actionable)
Attention to detail (without losing sight of the big picture able to mind all the little stuff that has a huge impact on the overall experience and outcome of a project)
Communications (exceptional listening skills; able to manage logistics, calendars and agendas that keep meetings and projects on time; able to interact and liaise effectively with clients and vendors)
Commitment (ability to leverage your resources to navigate challenges, find solutions and ensure reliable results on time and on budget)
Learning + application (can demonstrate basic concepts taught and/or guidance received is internalized and applied such that foundations are built which allow for more exposure to more complicated projects and greater responsibility/autonomous working)
In sum, we are looking for someone who is driven to take on new challenges and also has a keen interest in working with growth-oriented, fast-moving, and competitive clients who are leaders in dynamic and/or high-volume categories (e.g., consumer packaged goods, supplements, beverage, beer, spirits, restaurants, retail, fashion, finance, entertainment, pharma, biotech, etc.).
If this sounds like your ideal next step, add a note about yourself. We're looking forward to learning more about you!
